# Master regression suite

226 suites (211 core + 15 UI), 551 test-case IDs named in them. Every test_*.py / test_*.mjs in git is in it; the pre-commit hook rewrites this file when a test is added, changed or deleted.

Run: `python3 scripts/regression/master_suite.py run` (report in ~/scalp-regression/latest/report.html). Weekly: `python3 scripts/regression/schedule.py install`.

Not suites (left out): `backend/app/test_selector.py` (a scratch print of pick_strikes, no assertions); `backend/test_server.py` (a 6-line FastAPI ping app, no assertions); `.claude/*` (Claude skill bundles, not the app); `desktop/src-tauri/*` (build copies of backend/ and frontend/ (the source is run)).
